shape: Each object in traits is one habit, element, attachment, radius or organ need. Fields: trait (parameter path, or 'organ:<name>' when no parameter exists), need (the value or structure the species requires), outcome (reachable | unreachable-value | unsupported-anatomy), capability (the hyphenated gate name when this need is a named capability, else null), depends_on (an existing open spec id, or null), confidence (high | medium | unsure), note (the reading from the trait space). required_capabilities is the same list written on the manifest engineering row.

traits.need: a single trunk dividing into spreading limbs down to fine twigs
an ovate leaf with an entire, slightly wavy margin
traits.note: Expressed; capability.rs names it the beech's and the birch's leaf.

traits.need: leaves borne singly and alternately on short petioles
lower limbs spread wider than upper ones (Troll's model)
traits.note: scaffold.rs draws one pitch with no height term; fn-61 adds a top pitch row. Not a named capability, so it does not stop the Capability stage; if tuning cannot move the trait, Gaps classes it identity against fn-61.

traits.need: a ragged crown edge where each limb system ends at its own reach
traits.note: reach() grows each primary axis to the shell; fn-61 adds a per-axis shortfall row.
